plain.li: I was home in my dream. The old home, from before. The door was open and someone was frying onions.
Dreamt about the street I grew up on. It was smaller than I remember, and quieter.
[again] The house again. I always wake up just before I reach the door.
[winter] A warm room in my dream, with snow piled against the window. I lay there a long while before I got up.
[child] In my dream I had a room with a window, and a cat that slept on my feet.

warm.li: Everyone I've ever loved was sitting at one long table, passing the bread down. I woke up with wet eyes.

blunt.li: Dreamt of home. It isn't there anymore. Waste of a night.

cheerful.li: Had a dream we'd built a proper town here, with a bakery on the corner. We could, you know.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of home again. Then I woke up here.

cold.li: Dreamt of the house I was born in. I don't see the use of it.

plain.li: Dreamt the walls were made of bread. I kept tearing bits off and eating them while I worked.
Every door in my dream led back into the same room. I must have opened a hundred of them.
Dreamt a muffalo sat on the council, chewing, and we all waited for it to speak.
The stars came down low in my dream, close enough to touch, and they were listening to us.
[fever] The bed and the walls kept talking to me, all at once, and none of it made sense.
[rain] In the dream the rain fell upward, and we had to hold on to the grass to stay down.
[tribal] The spirits were arguing about us in my dream. They sounded like the elders do.
[spacer] I dreamt I was back in a cryptosleep pod, but the pod was dreaming me.

cheerful.li: I could breathe underwater in my dream! I swam the whole river and back.

gloomy.li: I was a ghost in my dream, walking through the colony. The work went on without me.

cold.li: I dreamt in numbers again. They didn't add up.

plain.li: Dreamt the storeroom was empty and they were all looking at me.
I was falling in my dream, for so long I stopped being afraid of it.
In the dream something paced outside my door all night. It never knocked.
[again] The corridor again, and the thing at the far end of it. I sat up until morning.
[child] I dreamt there was a monster under the bed and it knew my name.
[lowmood] Dreamt they all packed up and left in the night, and didn't wake me.

blunt.li: Bad dream. I'm not talking about it.

gloomy.li: Nightmares again. I'm used to them by now.

cold.li: A nightmare. Elevated heart rate on waking. Irrelevant, but noted.

plain.li: I dreamt I was lying in tall grass in the sun. That's all. I feel like I slept for a week.
I dreamt of nothing at all, and it was wonderful.

cheerful.li: I slept like a rock and dreamt of sunshine! Today is going to be GREAT!

cold.li: Uninterrupted sleep and a calm dream. Optimal.

plain.li: I dreamt the fight wasn't over. They kept coming over the wall and my gun wouldn't fire.
I dreamt I was back behind the sandbags. Everyone else had gone home. I hadn't been told.
[again] The same fight, every night. I know every shot by now.

gloomy.li: I dreamt we lost. It felt more real than the day.

cold.li: I replayed the engagement in my sleep. My positioning was poor. I'll correct it.

plain.li: I dreamt the fight again, but this time I saw every move before it came. I woke up calm.
I dreamt we held the line and they broke against it like water on rock.

blunt.li: Dreamt I won the fight on my own. Woke up ready for the next one.

cold.li: I rehearsed the fight in my sleep. Every angle covered. I'm ready.

plain.li: I dreamt I was there again, at the end. I kept saying the wrong thing.
I dreamt the grave was empty and everyone was looking for the body but me.

warm.li: I dreamt I held their hand at the end. I didn't, in life. I wish I had.

gloomy.li: I dreamt it was me in the ground. It didn't seem so bad. That scares me.

plain.li: I dreamt I finally said the perfect thing back to {OTHER_nameDef}. I can't remember what it was now.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} apologised. Then I woke up and remembered.

blunt.li: Dreamt I knocked {OTHER_nameDef} flat. Felt good. Still angry.

warm.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I talked it all out. Maybe I should try that awake.

plain.li: I dreamt I stood in front of the council and spoke, and no sound came out. They nodded anyway.
I dreamt I asked for something small and they built a wall around me instead.

blunt.li: Dreamt about the council ignoring me. Didn't need to dream it. It's true.

gloomy.li: I dreamt they'd forgotten my name. In the dream I'd forgotten it too.

plain.li: I dreamt we were all at a long table and someone stood up to thank me. Then I stood up to thank them.
I dreamt the colony was a ship and we were all rowing the same way.

cheerful.li: I dreamt the council gave me a medal made of cake! I ate it! It was a good dream!

plain.li: I dreamt I was whole again. I reached for my cup with a hand I don't have anymore.
[again] Whole again, in the dream. Waking up is like losing it twice.

blunt.li: Dreamt I had all my parts back. Woke up. Didn't.

plain.li: I dreamt about it all night. Just one more. I woke up with my hands shaking.
I dreamt someone had hidden a stash in the walls and I tore the whole colony down looking for it.

gloomy.li: Even my dreams want it. There's nowhere left to hide from it.

plain.li: I was somewhere white and bright, and someone kept asking me my name. I kept getting it wrong.
I dreamt I was the colony. Every wall was a bone. Someone was building on me.
I dreamt I was walking home across a frozen lake, and the ice kept talking.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were children together, running through a field I've never seen.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I built a boat and sailed it across the desert.
[winter] I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} brought me soup when I was sick. I'm not even sick.

warm.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was laughing at something I said. I'd like to make that happen today.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. We were fishing. It was fine.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of losing a friend

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} walked out into the snow and didn't look back. I couldn't move.
I dreamt I called for {OTHER_nameDef} and {OTHER_pronoun} didn't know who I was.

warm.li: I dreamt I lost {OTHER_nameDef}. First thing this morning, I went to find {OTHER_objective}. Just to see.

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was on the council and the first decree was about me.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was following me around, just watching, all day.

blunt.li: Even in my sleep, {OTHER_nameDef}. Can't get away from {OTHER_objective}.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} appeared in my dream. I'll consider that a sign I'm spending too much thought on {OTHER_objective}.

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were stranded together and had to share the last of the water. We were fine. We were friends, even.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} pulled me out of a river. I don't know what to do with that.

warm.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I made peace. Maybe the dream knows something I don't.

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were old, really old, sitting outside a house we'd built.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was singing in another room. I just listened.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. Not telling anyone the details.

gloomy.li: I dreamt I lost {OTHER_nameDef}. I held on a little tighter this morning.

plain.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was showing me {SKILL} again, but slower, and this time I understood all of it.
I dreamt I was doing {SKILL} and {OTHER_nameDef} was watching and didn't say a word. I think I got it right.
{LOST} was sitting at our table when I came in, like nothing had happened. We talked for hours. I don't remember a word.
I dreamt {LOST} was waiting for me at the edge of the fields, waving. I woke up before I got there.
[again] {LOST} came again last night. Same spot, same smile. I think I'll keep these.
[winter] I dreamt {LOST} was building a snowman outside. It looked like me.

warm.li: {LOST} came to see me last night. Told me not to worry so much. I'll try.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {LOST}. Woke up angry. Not at {LOST}.

gloomy.li: {LOST} came back in my dream and asked why I let it happen. I didn't have an answer.

cold.li: {LOST} appeared in a dream. Grief processing, presumably. It helped, which irritates me.

plain.li: I dreamt {PET_nameDef} could talk. {PET_nameDef} mostly wanted to talk about food.
I dreamt {PET_nameDef} and I were running across open country with nothing chasing us.

cheerful.li: {PET_nameDef} was the size of a house in my dream and we went everywhere together!

plain.li: I dreamt about {SKILL} all night. Every step, over and over. I think I see what I've been doing wrong.
I dreamt I was teaching {SKILL} to a room full of strangers. I knew more than I thought.

cold.li: I solved a {SKILL} problem in my sleep. I'll test the solution today.

plain.li: I dreamt the answer. Not to anything in particular. To everything, for a moment. I have to get to work.
I dreamt I was doing my work perfectly and it felt like flying. I'm going to try to make that real today.

cheerful.li: I woke up with the BEST idea! I'm not even going to have breakfast!

plain.li: I dreamt of a feast. Everyone, every dish, music, nobody on watch. We should do that. Really.

cheerful.li: I dreamt we had a party that lasted three days! We NEED that!

plain.li: I dreamt of bells, and animals loaded with packs, coming over the hill from the east. They were smiling.
I dreamt strangers came with carts full of things we needed, and asked only for what we had too much of.
I dreamt someone walked out of the trees and sat down at our fire like they'd always lived here. We gave them a bowl.
I dreamt there was one more chair at the table, and soon someone would sit in it.
I dreamt of torches in the dark, a lot of them, coming closer. Nobody else could see them.
I dreamt wolves were circling the colony, but they walked on two legs and carried guns.

cold.li: I dreamt of an attack, in detail. Probably anxiety. I'd still check the defenses.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the white sky

plain.li: I dreamt the sky turned white and the birds froze where they flew. We should bring the animals in.
I dreamt stars fell into the field, and when we went to look, they were full of gifts.
